reasoning: The document has a weak composite fidelity score (0.6526) with particularly poor structural (0.46) and visual (0.47) scores. Multiple major defects are present, including broken heading hierarchy, images placed in the wrong context, 66 displaced hyperlinks, and retained header/footer elements. While content preservation is high, the severe structural and visual issues require human intervention.

In the HTML, these words are rendered as plain, unstyled text. Additionally, row headers in the first column of the table on page 10 lose their bold formatting.
